gloss: conferring a decoration; awarding an order

definitions.gloss: conferring a decoration; awarding an order of merit
definitions.explanation: The formal act of bestowing a government decoration or order upon a person for distinguished service or achievement.

examples.japanese: {叙勲|じょくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received notification of being awarded a decoration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められ→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、{叙勲|じょくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄|えい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浴|よく}した。
examples.english: His long years of meritorious service were recognized, and he had the honor of receiving a decoration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叙勲|じょくん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧や⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧さまざまな⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}した→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the spring and autumn conferment of decorations, people who have distinguished themselves in various fields such as education, medicine, and community service are honored.

notes:
A compound of {叙|じょ} (to confer, to bestow) and {勲|くん} (merit, decoration). In Japan, the government confers decorations twice a year — in spring (around April 29, the Emperor's birthday-era holiday) and autumn (around November 3, Culture Day). Recipients include people with distinguished service in public life, culture, education, and other fields.

The suru-verb form {叙勲|じょくん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to confer a decoration" (from the government's perspective).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {叙勲|じょくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a decoration
- {叙勲|じょくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄|えい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浴|よく}する: to have the honor of receiving a decoration
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叙勲|じょくん}: spring conferment of decorations
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叙勲|じょくん}: autumn conferment of decorations
- {叙勲|じょくん}⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧: candidates for decoration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勲章|くんしょう}→勲章：21244_kunshou⟧: decoration; medal; order — the physical medal or badge itself
- {褒章|ほうしょう}: medal of honor — a different category of government honor in Japan
- ⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧: commendation; recognition — a broader term for any formal acknowledgment of achievement
